extractions.label: minehead_upgrade_cost_to_max_1
extractions.expression: Array.from({length: Math.max(0, Math.min(idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.MineheadUPG[1][1], idleon.getAttr("Research")[8][1] + 10) - idleon.getAttr("Research")[8][1])}, (_, offset) => 6 * (1 / (1 + idleon.callFunction("Minehead", "UpgradeQTY", 26, 0) / 100)) * Math.max(.1, 1 - Math.max(idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "RoG_BonusQTY", 1, 0), idleon.callFunction("SushiStuff", "RoG_BonusQTY", 16, 0)) / 100) * Math.pow(idleon.getAttr("CustomLists").h.MineheadUPG[1][2], idleon.getAttr("Research")[8][1] + offset)).reduce((sum, cost) => sum + cost, 0)
extractions.description: Native-source sum for the genuine saved Numbahs progression to its next ten levels or listed cap, whichever comes first; source formula at idleon1.23.txt:244124-132.
